description: ALLOCATE statement (dynamic storage), ISO §2023:14.9.3 - introduced 2002. ACTIVE: both formats bind (n CHARACTERS RETURNING p -> a fresh StorageCell window pointer, GR1 round-up / GR2 <=0 -> NULL no EC / GR6 INITIALIZED zero-fill; based-item -> the implicit pointer takes a cell of the template width, GR3/GR4a/GR4b) and the based INITIALIZED form lowers per GR7 to the spec's INITIALIZE ... WITH FILLER ALL TO VALUE THEN TO DEFAULT expansion (a BoundSequence over the ONE INITIALIZE mechanism; golden 2002/allocate_initialized). INITIALIZED is a phrase of this gated statement - no separate matrix row (the phrase-level precedent).
